meta.note: Per-sprite PNG layers for the hydro dams (R3, #270). Two sprites: dam_x spans a river that runs along y (the 2×1 footprint, the wall crossing in x) and dam_y spans a river that runs along x (the 1×2 footprint, the wall crossing in y). The `anchor` is the pixel that lands on the SOUTH VERTEX OF THE RIVER (SITE) TILE — the one fixed point of a dam, since the bank tile of the footprint moves with `side` — exactly what src/iso/depth.ts' drawOrigin default branch (the south-vertex convention, no `center`) places the anchor on when the DrawItem's tx,ty come from dams.ts' damDrawOrigin. The placeholder PNGs are flat, clearly marked 'PLACEHOLDER', and sized/anchored so the lead's generated art can be dropped in under the same names with no code change.

dam_x.note: Dam across a river running along y (banks east/west). DrawItem origin = damDrawOrigin = [wx-1, wy]; the anchor lands on the water tile's south vertex. PLACEHOLDER art — replace under the same name/anchor.
